title: 第23章 买官第24章 张让＆交易改
content_zh:
沐云看着主位上的张让，微微笑道:“是啊！张爷爷，我来这就是要请你吃糖的，你要不要先来一点尝尝?“
沐云拿出了一块手巾，然后悄悄的在里面塞了十几枚毫金币，这才递了出去。
张让身后的一位小黄门，便走上前来，将东西拿到了张让手上。
张让一看，顿时便笑了，他对着沐云说道:“不错!的确是好糖，呵呵呵。“
收下毫金币之后，张让的眼中便带着揶揄之色，说道:“小娃子，现在糖你送出去了，咱家也收下了，那你是不是也该走了呢?“
“就这些糖，张爷爷你够吃吗?沐云问道。“
“够吃又如何?不够吃又如何?“张让绕有兴致的问道。
“够吃的话，我就走了啊！“沐云理所当然的说道。
“那不够吃呢?“张让问道。
沐云没有回答，只是看着张让，眼中带着笑意。
“滑头!“看着沐云的举动，张让笑骂了一声，他拿出了两枚毫金币出来，说道:“拿去尝尝吧！你们可以出去了。“
两个小黄门在谢过一声后，便退着身子走出了大门，顺带着还把门给关了起来。
“说吧！你个小狐狸。不用遮遮掩掩的了，你来找咱家有什么目的?“张让开门见山的问道。
“我想建城，可是我没有建村令和相应的图纸。“沐云直白的说道。
“可以，只要你有钱，要多少咱家都能给你。＂张让回答得很快。
＂我要买官位。＂沐云看着张让，认真的说道。
＂小娃子，你说啥？咱家没听清楚，你在说一次？＂张让讶异的问了声。
＂我说，我要买官位。＂沐云看着张让，非常认真的说道。
＂小娃子，虽然咱家不清楚你是哪个世家的子弟，但是说要买官，你会买那些小官？你要是年纪在大一点，咱家劝都不会劝你一句，但是你一个四五岁的小娃儿，是在逗咱家吗？咱家今天心情好，咱家高兴，所以咱家在给你一次机会，你真要买官？＂张让看着沐云，眼中的笑意逐渐散去，取而代之的是一丝的冷意。
＂我说，我确定，我要买官！＂沐云再三的强调着。

双眼一眯，张让冷笑道：＂行！咱家一时善心来着，却被个小娃儿当驴肝肺，很好！很好！咱家就看你买得起，还是买不起。＂随手从袖中掏出了两张纸，丢给了沐云。
＂小娃儿，文官武将，任君挑选，你千万别选低了！让咱家笑话你阿！也千万别选好了官位，却没那个钱阿！阿？＂张让在一旁不断的嘲讽着。
＂文官，没兴趣。＂沐云随手将其中一张纸，丢回了张让手中。
＂死鸭子嘴硬，咱家就看你最后选什么官。＂张让冷笑道。
沐云拿着武将官位的表单，开始思索着要买到哪个职位才好。
＂帝望＂中的大汉帝国，武将官职由高而低为：大将军、骠骑将军、车骑将军、卫将军、前将军、后将军、左将军、右将军、四征、四镇、四平、四安，再往下便是所谓的杂号将军、俾将军、校尉等等。
其中，大将军、骠骑将军、车骑将军、卫将军为正一品，前、后、左、右将军为从一品，四征将军为正二品，四镇将军为从二品，四平将军为正三品，四安将军为从三品。至于杂号将军，则属于四品，俾将军属于五品。
content_en:
Mu Yun looked at Zhang Rang on the main seat, smiled slightly and said: "Yes! Grandpa Zhang, I am here to treat you to some sweets. Do you want to try some first?"
Mu Yun took out a handkerchief and quietly stuffed a dozen gold coins in it before handing it out.
A little Huangmen behind Zhang Rang stepped forward and took the thing into Zhang Rang's hand.
Zhang Rang smiled immediately when he saw it. He said to Mu Yun: "Not bad! It is indeed a good candy, hehehe."
After accepting the gold coins, Zhang Rang had a teasing look in his eyes and said, "Little boy, now that you have given away the candy and our family has accepted it, shouldn't it be time for you to leave too?"
"Just these candies, Grandpa Zhang, do you have enough?" Mu Yun asked.
"So what if it's enough? What if it's not enough?" Zhang Rangrao asked with interest.
"If there's enough to eat, I'll leave!" Mu Yun said matter-of-factly.
"Isn't it enough to eat?" Zhang Rang asked.
Mu Yun didn't answer, just looked at Zhang Rang with a smile in his eyes.
"Slippery!" Looking at Mu Yun's actions, Zhang Rang laughed and cursed. He took out two gold coins and said, "Take them and have a taste! You can go out."
After the two little yellow gatekeepers thanked them, they stepped back and walked out of the gate, closing the door behind them.
"Tell me! You little fox. There's no need to be secretive. What's the purpose of coming to our house?" Zhang Rang asked straight to the point.
"I want to build a city, but I don't have a village building order or the corresponding drawings." Mu Yun said bluntly.
"Yes, as long as you have money, we can give you any amount you want." Zhang Rang answered quickly.
"I want to buy an official position." Mu Yun looked at Zhang Rang and said seriously.
"Little boy, what are you talking about? We didn't hear clearly. Are you talking about it again?" Zhang Rang asked in surprise.
"I said, I want to buy an official position." Mu Yun looked at Zhang Rang and said very seriously.
"Little boy, although our family doesn't know which family you are from, but if you want to buy an official position, will you buy those small officials? If you were older, our family would not even advise you, but you are a four or five-year-old kid. Son, are you kidding us? We are in a good mood today and we are happy, so we are giving you a chance. Do you really want to buy an official position?" Zhang Rang looked at Mu Yun, the smile in his eyes gradually disappeared, replaced by a hint of coldness.
"I said, I'm sure, I want to buy an official position!" Mu Yun emphasized again and again.
Narrowing his eyes, Zhang Rang sneered: "Okay! Our family was kind-hearted for a while, but was treated like a donkey by a little kid. Very good! Very good! Our family will see if you can afford it or not." He casually took out two pieces of paper from his sleeve and threw them to Mu Yun.
"Little boy, you have your choice of civil servants and military generals. Don't choose too low! Let our family laugh at you! Don't choose an official position but don't have the money! Huh?" Zhang Rang kept mocking at the side.
"Civil official, I'm not interested." Mu Yun casually threw one of the pieces of paper back into Zhang Rang's hands.
"You're such a tough talker, our family depends on which official you choose in the end." Zhang Rang sneered.
Mu Yun took the list of military officer positions and began to think about which position he should buy.
In the Han Empire in "Emperor's Hope", the military generals' official positions from high to low are: General, General of Hussars, General of Chariots, General of Guards, General of the Front, General of the Back, General of the Left, General of the Right, Four Expeditions, Four Towns, Four Pings, Four Ans, and further down are the so-called miscellaneous generals, generals, captains, etc.
Among them, the general, the hussar general, the cavalry general, and the guard general are the first rank, the front, rear, left, and right generals are the first rank, the four expedition generals are the second rank, the four town generals are the second rank, the Siping generals are the third rank, and the Si'an generals are the third rank. As for the miscellaneous generals, they belong to the fourth rank, and the generals belong to the fifth rank.
